$note: Per-listing overrides for OpenClaw AI Agent (Telegram + Browser), merged over template.json by upsert.py when TEMPLATE_OVERLAY=overlay.telegram.json. Only deploy-form copy differs; image and behavior are the Browser sheet's. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN stays optional because the Browser sheet does not require it and boot.sh only adds Telegram when it is set.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token. In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot, pick a name and a username ending in bot, and paste the token here. Optional: you can add it later and redeploy. After deploy, DM your bot and approve the pairing code in the Control UI.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: AI provider key for your agent. Set at least one: this, or OpenAI, OpenRouter or Gemini below. You can change keys later and redeploy.
